function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Retrieve the current location of the user.

function.name: search_locations
function.description: Search for locations using keywords, and optionally filter by open status, rating, distance, and result count.

keywords.description: Specify keywords to search for locations.

open_now.description: Indicate if only currently open locations should be returned.

min_rating.description: Set the minimum rating for locations. Value must be between 0 and 5.

base_location_address.description: Provide the base location address for distance calculations, formatted as 'street address, city, zip code'.

max_distance.description: Set the maximum search distance in miles.

max_results.description: Specify the maximum number of results to return.

function.name: get_location_details
function.description: Retrieve details for a specified location.

location_address.description: Provide the address of the location, formatted as 'street address, city, zip code'.

function.name: get_directions
function.description: Retrieve directions between two or more locations using a specified mode of transportation.

start_location_address.description: Provide the starting location address, formatted as 'street address, city, zip code'.

end_location.description: Provide the ending location address, formatted as 'street address, city, zip code'.

function.name: geocoding
function.description: Convert a location address to geographic coordinates.

location_address.description: Provide the address of the location, formatted as 'street address, city, zip code'.

function.name: reverse_geocoding
function.description: Convert geographic coordinates to a location address.

coordinates.description: Provide the geographic coordinates in the format 'latitude,longitude'.

function.name: get_location_reviews
function.description: Retrieve reviews for a specified location.

location_address.description: Provide the address of the location, formatted as 'street address, city, zip code'.

function.name: search_address_book
function.description: Search for locations in the address book using keywords.

keywords.description: Specify keywords to search for locations in the address book.

function.name: add_address
function.description: Add a new address to the address book.

name.description: Specify the name for the address.

address.description: Provide the address of the location, formatted as 'street address, city, zip code'.

note.description: Add a note for the address.
